title: Three Weeks of Talk: The First Cable Across the Ocean
summary: The episode tells how Cyrus Field's company laid the first telegraph cable across the Atlantic in August 1858, running from Valentia Island in Ireland to Trinity Bay in Newfoundland. The cable failed after about three weeks, in part because Wildman Whitehouse sent high voltage through it. The episode then follows the cable laid by the Great Eastern, which in 1866 joined the two continents for good.
